text:
lina (AM): Quick update — we closed Nimbus Health as a Dedicated + ISV marketplace partner! :confetti_ball: Signed a two-year reserved capacity contract with a marketplace listing planned for next quarter.

diego (SE): Theyre deploying their clinical summarization model on our Dedicated clusters. Benchmarks yesterday looked great: <100ms P50 on 512-token summaries with seq-parallel kernels.

rebecca (Sales): Contract signed and countersigned this AM. Rebecca: adding the deployment slots and reserved instance IDs to the CRM.

omar (CS): Onboarding doc link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/nimbus-health-dedicated. Security checklist includes HIPAA BAA and logging export setup.

ciara (Product): Product wants a short 2-line case blurb for the marketplace: can we get an aspiration metric (latency or cost) and a customer quote?

diego (SE): Two bullets: "<100ms P50 for 512-token summaries" and "20% cost reduction vs their previous cloud setup after batching/quantization".

lina (AM): I'll reach out to their CTO for a quote and permission to publish the logo. Also coordinating with legal on the co-marketing terms.

deploy-bot: Marketplace listing ticket created: MKT-9912 (owner: ciara)

rebecca (Sales): Kickoff scheduled Tue 11:00 PT. Omar, please loop infra & security.

omar (CS): On it. We'll prepare a dedicated runbook and a telemetry dashboard to capture initial QPS and error trends.

ciara (Product): Adding a template for the marketplace blurb: 1) short problem statement 2) Redwood solution & metrics 3) customer quote. Will push a PR to marketing repo.

lina (AM): Awesome team. This is a big win in healthcare partnerships. 

(reacted :rocket: by rebecca (Sales), :white_check_mark: by ciara (Product))
